competitors.name: The Raley's Companies
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Raley's plans to close three Raley's stores and one Nob Hill Foods location, following three closures earlier in 2026. The company cited local market conditions and long-term financial sustainability while still planning a 40,000-square-foot Raley's O-N-E Market opening in Madera, California, in March 2027.

competitors.name: Traditional grocers / young-parent shoppers
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported AlixPartners findings that younger parents are more likely to split grocery spend across channels, buy online weekly, and purchase prepared foods. AlixPartners warned retailers could lose 15% of loyal customers in five years if they do not adapt to Gen Z families' channel and meal-solution behavior.

competitors.name: Grocery retailers facing fuel-cost pressure
competitors.action: Grocery Dive published Upside analysis showing fuel spikes reduce grocery visits and basket value. Across three years and more than 1,000 stores, every 1% increase in gas prices corresponded with a 0.51% drop in grocery visits and a 0.59% drop in grocery revenue, with shoppers cutting extras and switching to store brands.

trends.magnitude: Raley's has seven closures scheduled or completed across 2026 and early 2027 while still investing selectively in one new store.
trends.context: Regional grocers are pruning weaker locations instead of broad expansion. For Real Dough, account health and store-level velocity matter more when buyers are under pressure to justify freezer space.

trends.magnitude: Almost three-quarters of young parents used at least three channels for groceries in 2025; more than 60% bought groceries online at least weekly.
trends.context: Premium frozen pizza needs to work across store, digital, prepared-food and convenience-led shopping contexts. Young-family demand is less tied to one traditional grocer and more tied to fast meal solutions.

trends.magnitude: Every 1% gas-price increase aligned with a 0.51% visit decline and 0.59% grocery-revenue decline in Upside's analysis.
trends.context: When outside household costs rise, shoppers trim extras and specialty items first. Real Dough's premium positioning needs clear meal value and retailer promo fit during fuel-driven budget pressure.
